card.name: Linking words before suicidality or mania terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, of, the, e.g.,) right before a psychiatric risk term such as suicidal impulses or family history of mania or bipolar disorder, in antidepressant warnings.

modes.label: Link before suicidal impulses
modes.description: The words 'of' or 'the' after 'and/or' in the worsening-of-depression and emergence-of-suicidal-impulses sentence.
modes.example: and/or the emergence<< of>> suicidal impulses has not been established

modes.label: Link before family history
modes.description: 'or' or 'e.g.,' just before a family history of mania or bipolar disorder.
modes.example: patients with a history<< or>> family history of mania or hypoman

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words for male, female, boy and girl, so there is no clear link to the pattern; the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before the warning about suicidal thoughts or a family history of mania in antidepressant labels.
